<style id="wp-custom-css">
#onetrust-pc-sdk ul.ot-host-opt {
font-size: 23.5px;
}
#onetrust-banner-sdk, #onetrust-pc-sdk, #ot-sdk-cookie-policy, #ot-sync-ntfy {
	font-size: 18px !important;
}
/* Header */
.fusion-standard-logo {
	max-width: 112px;
}
/*.fusion-header .fusion-logo {
	margin-top: 2px !important;
}*/
.fusion-secondary-header {
	display: none;
}
 .fusion-main-menu>ul#menu-megamenu>li {
 margin-top: 0;
}
.fusion-mobile-menu-icons a {
	margin-top: 12px;
}
@media only screen and (max-width: 950px) {
.fusion-header {
	padding-top: 10px !important;
	padding-bottom: 15px !important;
}
header {
 	margin-top: 0 !important;
	margin-bottom: 0 !important;
}
}
#menu-item-25892 .fusion-button,
#menu-item-26097 .fusion-button {
  background: white;
  color: #333333;
  border: 1px solid #53016b;
	padding: 6px 14px;
}
#menu-item-25892 .fusion-button:hover,
#menu-item-26097 .fusion-button:hover {
	background: #3398d1;
	border: 1px solid #3398d1;
	color: white;
}
#menu-item-25891, #menu-item-25892, #menu-item-26097 {
	padding-right: 15px !important;
}
#menu-item-25894 {
	padding-right: 0 !important;
}
#menu-item-25891 .fusion-button {
	padding: 7px 14px;
	font-size: 14px;
}
#menu-item-25894  .menu-text {
	font-size: 12px;
	font-weight: 400;
}
#menu-item-25894  .fa-lock:before {
	font-size: 12px;
  margin-right: 6px;
}

/* Top banner */
/* header {
	margin-top: 10px;
	margin-bottom: 10px;
} */
.top-banner {
  margin-top: -20px;
	padding: 26px 20px 6px 20px;
	color: white; 
	display: flex; 
	width: 100%; 
	background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--awb-custom_color_4) 0%, var(--awb-custom_color_2) 100%); 
	justify-content: center; 
	align-items: center; 
	text-align: center;
	font-size: 15px;
	}
@media screen and (max-width: 700px) {
	.top-banner { 
		flex-direction: column;
	}
}
.top-bar-link {
  color: white; 
	text-decoration: underline; 
	text-underline-offset: 2px;
}
.top-bar-link:hover {
	color: #bcc900;
}
.top-bar-link:after {
  content: "\f35d";
	font-family: "Font Awesome 5 Free";
	color: white;
	text-decoration: none;
	display: inline-block;
  margin-left: 6px;
  font-weight: 900;
}
.top-bar-link:hover:after {
	color: #bcc900;
}
/*
#menu-item-25891, .free-trial-btn, .free-trial-section {
 display: none;
} */

.fusion-dropdown-submenu.menu-item-has-children>a::after {
    content: "\25B8";
    position: absolute;
	  color: #1cd4d4;
    right: 5px;
    top: 50%;
    transform: translateY(-50%);
    font-size: 18px;
}
#menu-item-25439 > .sub-menu {
 width: 180px;
}
#menu-item-25418 > .sub-menu {
	width: 160px
}
#menu-item-27986 > .sub-menu {
left: 180px;
width: 240px;
}

.filter-link[data-selected="podcast"] {
  position: relative;
  padding-right: 28px;
}

.filter-link[data-selected="podcast"]::after {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  top: -11px;
  left: -4px;
  width: 86px;
  height: 22px;
  background: url("/wp-content/uploads/2026/11/aici-logo-small.webp") center / contain no-repeat;
  pointer-events: none;
}
#filter-layout1-1 {
	margin-top: 30px;
}
</style>

							<sr7-txt id="SR7_64_1-190-5" class="sr7-layer">As AI shopping assistants transform how consumers find and buy products, DaVinci Commerce is helping brands stay visible and competitive with its new Brand Agent and Product Context Memory technology, connecting brands with AI assistants like ChatGPT and Meta Muse.</sr7-txt>

							<sr7-txt id="SR7_64_1-189-4" class="sr7-layer">Read more <i style="font-size: 12px; vertical-align: middle; margin-left: 2px;" class="fa-arrow-right"></i></sr7-txt>

It ends with the consumer buying the product, typically on a retailer’s website.</div></div></div><div class="fusion-panel panel-default panel-e16afcad0ae03ee9d fusion-toggle-no-divider fusion-toggle-boxed-mode"><div class="panel-heading"><h3 class="panel-title toggle" id="toggle_e16afcad0ae03ee9d"><a aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="e16afcad0ae03ee9d" role="button" data-toggle="collapse" data-target="#e16afcad0ae03ee9d" href="#e16afcad0ae03ee9d"><span class="fusion-toggle-icon-wrapper" aria-hidden="true"><i class="fa-fusion-box active-icon awb-icon-minus" aria-hidden="true"></i><i class="fa-fusion-box inactive-icon awb-icon-plus" aria-hidden="true"></i></span><span class="fusion-toggle-heading">How is DaVinci Commerce different from a typical GEO or AI-visibility tool?</span></a></h3></div><div id="e16afcad0ae03ee9d" class="panel-collapse collapse " aria-labelledby="toggle_e16afcad0ae03ee9d"><div class="panel-body toggle-content fusion-clearfix">
<p><strong>GEO gets you cited. We get your products bought.</strong> GEO publishes content for LLMs to cite. We’re agentic commerce infrastructure: we measure, enrich and deliver your product catalog to AI shopping agents, always on.</p>
</div></div></div><div class="fusion-panel panel-default panel-4f58822f1e027c00d fusion-toggle-no-divider fusion-toggle-boxed-mode"><div class="panel-heading"><h3 class="panel-title toggle" id="toggle_4f58822f1e027c00d"><a aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="4f58822f1e027c00d" role="button" data-toggle="collapse" data-target="#4f58822f1e027c00d" href="#4f58822f1e027c00d"><span class="fusion-toggle-icon-wrapper" aria-hidden="true"><i class="fa-fusion-box active-icon awb-icon-minus" aria-hidden="true"></i><i class="fa-fusion-box inactive-icon awb-icon-plus" aria-hidden="true"></i></span><span class="fusion-toggle-heading">Isn't this just enrichment?</span></a></h3></div><div id="4f58822f1e027c00d" class="panel-collapse collapse " aria-labelledby="toggle_4f58822f1e027c00d"><div class="panel-body toggle-content fusion-clearfix">
<p><strong>What most other vendors call enrichment is just catalog and attribute completeness.</strong> We enrich every SKU with the context shoppers use, from reviews, social content and lifestyle content. Product Context Memory connects a need to the right product. Someone mentions a wedding, we surface the dress; no one asked for a product by name, we made the connection anyway. That translation, from conversation to product, is what attribute enrichment alone can’t do.</p>
</div></div></div><div class="fusion-panel panel-default panel-684d2656a933893a9 fusion-toggle-no-divider fusion-toggle-boxed-mode"><div class="panel-heading"><h3 class="panel-title toggle" id="toggle_684d2656a933893a9"><a aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="684d2656a933893a9" role="button" data-toggle="collapse" data-target="#684d2656a933893a9" href="#684d2656a933893a9"><span class="fusion-toggle-icon-wrapper" aria-hidden="true"><i class="fa-fusion-box active-icon awb-icon-minus" aria-hidden="true"></i><i class="fa-fusion-box inactive-icon awb-icon-plus" aria-hidden="true"></i></span><span class="fusion-toggle-heading">What does Agentic Commerce Experience Platform mean?</span></a></h3></div><div id="684d2656a933893a9" class="panel-collapse collapse " aria-labelledby="toggle_684d2656a933893a9"><div class="panel-body toggle-content fusion-clearfix">
<p><strong>One continuous loop: measurement, enrichment, machine-readable discovery, experience and purchase.</strong> Your brand is found across LLMs, then chosen once shoppers get there. The Agentic Discoverability Engine handles measurement and enrichment, with Brand Agent driving machine-readable discovery. The Agentic BrandStore handles experience and purchase. All run on a single, no-code platform, powered by Product Context Memory, a rich database of every enrichment for every product SKU.</p>
</div></div></div><div class="fusion-panel panel-default panel-f37f5c55283d8c703 fusion-toggle-no-divider fusion-toggle-boxed-mode"><div class="panel-heading"><h3 class="panel-title toggle" id="toggle_f37f5c55283d8c703"><a aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="f37f5c55283d8c703" role="button" data-toggle="collapse" data-target="#f37f5c55283d8c703" href="#f37f5c55283d8c703"><span class="fusion-toggle-icon-wrapper" aria-hidden="true"><i class="fa-fusion-box active-icon awb-icon-minus" aria-hidden="true"></i><i class="fa-fusion-box inactive-icon awb-icon-plus" aria-hidden="true"></i></span><span class="fusion-toggle-heading">Do I need to replace my PIM?</span></a></h3></div><div id="f37f5c55283d8c703" class="panel-collapse collapse " aria-labelledby="toggle_f37f5c55283d8c703"><div class="panel-body toggle-content fusion-clearfix">
<p><strong>No. We build on your existing stack.</strong> Connect your product catalog, PIM/PXM or PDPs. We enrich the catalog with reviews, social conversation and lifestyle context and push it back through the systems you already use.</p>
</div></div></div><div class="fusion-panel panel-default panel-fc5afda466d5057f3 fusion-toggle-no-divider fusion-toggle-boxed-mode"><div class="panel-heading"><h3 class="panel-title toggle" id="toggle_fc5afda466d5057f3"><a aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="fc5afda466d5057f3" role="button" data-toggle="collapse" data-target="#fc5afda466d5057f3" href="#fc5afda466d5057f3"><span class="fusion-toggle-icon-wrapper" aria-hidden="true"><i class="fa-fusion-box active-icon awb-icon-minus" aria-hidden="true"></i><i class="fa-fusion-box inactive-icon awb-icon-plus" aria-hidden="true"></i></span><span class="fusion-toggle-heading">How do I know it's working?</span></a></h3></div><div id="fc5afda466d5057f3" class="panel-collapse collapse " aria-labelledby="toggle_fc5afda466d5057f3"><div class="panel-body toggle-content fusion-clearfix">
<p><strong>We measure revenue impact, not visibility.</strong> Product Discovery Insights tracks whether each SKU surfaces with a link to buy, then A/B tests raw against enriched catalogs to prove the lift.</p>
</div></div></div><div class="fusion-panel panel-default panel-8c035479aed3603b5 fusion-toggle-no-divider fusion-toggle-boxed-mode"><div class="panel-heading"><h3 class="panel-title toggle" id="toggle_8c035479aed3603b5"><a aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="8c035479aed3603b5" role="button" data-toggle="collapse" data-target="#8c035479aed3603b5" href="#8c035479aed3603b5"><span class="fusion-toggle-icon-wrapper" aria-hidden="true"><i class="fa-fusion-box active-icon awb-icon-minus" aria-hidden="true"></i><i class="fa-fusion-box inactive-icon awb-icon-plus" aria-hidden="true"></i></span><span class="fusion-toggle-heading">What is a Brand Agent?</span></a></h3></div><div id="8c035479aed3603b5" class="panel-collapse collapse " aria-labelledby="toggle_8c035479aed3603b5"><div class="panel-body toggle-content fusion-clearfix">

<p><strong>Brands and retailers.</strong> Most enrichment tools serve only retailers, and most AI visibility tools stop at measurement. We work on both the catalog and the agent side, for both.</p>
</div></div></div><div class="fusion-panel panel-default panel-ad6b8ff8269719058 fusion-toggle-no-divider fusion-toggle-boxed-mode"><div class="panel-heading"><h3 class="panel-title toggle" id="toggle_ad6b8ff8269719058"><a aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="ad6b8ff8269719058" role="button" data-toggle="collapse" data-target="#ad6b8ff8269719058" href="#ad6b8ff8269719058"><span class="fusion-toggle-icon-wrapper" aria-hidden="true"><i class="fa-fusion-box active-icon awb-icon-minus" aria-hidden="true"></i><i class="fa-fusion-box inactive-icon awb-icon-plus" aria-hidden="true"></i></span><span class="fusion-toggle-heading">What is DaVinci Commerce Marketing, and how does it relate to Agentic Commerce?</span></a></h3></div><div id="ad6b8ff8269719058" class="panel-collapse collapse " aria-labelledby="toggle_ad6b8ff8269719058"><div class="panel-body toggle-content fusion-clearfix">
<p>DaVinci Commerce Marketing turns brand templates and product feeds into personalized, retailer-compliant content, generated with AI, across every paid and owned channel. </div></div></div><div class="fusion-panel panel-default panel-d845294a4a91c8975 fusion-toggle-no-divider fusion-toggle-boxed-mode"><div class="panel-heading"><h3 class="panel-title toggle" id="toggle_d845294a4a91c8975"><a aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="d845294a4a91c8975" role="button" data-toggle="collapse" data-target="#d845294a4a91c8975" href="#d845294a4a91c8975"><span class="fusion-toggle-icon-wrapper" aria-hidden="true"><i class="fa-fusion-box active-icon awb-icon-minus" aria-hidden="true"></i><i class="fa-fusion-box inactive-icon awb-icon-plus" aria-hidden="true"></i></span><span class="fusion-toggle-heading">Can I use Commerce Marketing without the Agentic Commerce discovery and experience tools?</span></a></h3></div><div id="d845294a4a91c8975" class="panel-collapse collapse " aria-labelledby="toggle_d845294a4a91c8975"><div class="panel-body toggle-content fusion-clearfix">
